name: Signal Cluster S18: Streak & Freshness Counting
description: Tests: streak_length(direction=up/down/bidirectional), barssince. Consecutive up/down days, signal freshness, time-based exit gate.
source:
# =============================================================================
# SIGNAL CLUSTER S18: Streak Length & Bars Since
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()
close = src.c

# === STREAK COUNTING ===
is_up_day = close > (close >> 1)
up_streak = streak_length(is_up_day)
down_streak = streak_length(is_up_day)
signed_streak = streak_length(is_up_day)

# === SIGNAL FRESHNESS ===
sma_200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)
entry_signal = crossover(close, sma_200)
signal_age = barssince(entry_signal)
is_fresh = signal_age < 5

# === REPORTERS ===
xy_lines(
    title='Consecutive Up/Down Days',
    category='Streak',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Signed Streak', color=Color.Blue)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=signed_streak)

xy_lines(
    title='Signal Age (bars since entry)',
    category='Freshness',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Bars Since Entry', color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=signal_age)
